common_gotchas: Use rendersimpleTOP for new plans; simplerenderTOP is a legacy alias-style card.
This workflow does not expose separate Camera COMP or Light COMP control surfaces.
Background alpha matters because the background color is premultiplied.
POP render/display flags are ignored by the current Render Simple operator.
key_concepts: Simple Render TOP is a legacy/redirect-style reference; current planning should prefer Render Simple TOP / rendersimpleTOP.
Render Simple renders one POP directly without Camera, Geometry, or Light COMPs.
The current operator ignores POP render/display flags and renders the selected POP path.
Material can come from the internal Phong controls or an external MAT node.
